packet.headline_seed: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain
packet.description_seed: Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.

what: Boy, 13, dies during World Cup celebrations in Spain

clean_source_blocks.text: Spain's streets were filled with revellers overnight on Sunday - pictured here in Los Palacios, Seville, more than 400km south of the incident A 13-year-old boy was killed after part of a fountain collapsed in Salamanca province, northwestern Spain, during the country's World Cup victory celebrations. Two other young people were injured, emergency services told the BBC, including one child who was taken to hospital with a possible broken bone in his leg. Youth were celebrating Spain's victory inside the Árbol Gordo fountain in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo, when it partially collapsed around 00:30 local time (23:30 BST). "What was supposed to be a celebration for the victory in the Spanish National Football Team's World Cup has turned into a tragedy," Ciudad Rodrigo's town hall posted on social media. The remains of the Árbol Gordo fountain in Ciudad Rodrigo

A TEENAGER HAS died, and several people were injured after a fountain collapsed during celebrations of Spain’s victory in the World Cup. “The city hall of Ciudad Rodrigo expresses its sadness and presents its condolences for the death of a boy of 13,” the municipality said on a Facebook post. “What should have been a celebration of Spain’s team in the football World Cup turned into tragedy,” it said, adding that several others were injured. Ciudad Rodrigo is a small city in the Salamanca region, about 25km east of the border with Portugal. “A few minutes after 12:30 am local time, rescue services received calls over a fountain collapsing on numerous people,” emergency services said in a post on X. It also said another young person had been injured.

A YOUNG teenager died and several others were injured when a fountain collapsed during early Monday morning celebrations of Spain’s World Cup final victory over Argentina. Emergency services received calls shortly after 12.30am reporting that a fountain had collapsed on multiple victims in Ciudad Rodrigo in the Castilla y Leon region- close to the border with Portugal. The victim, a 13-year-old boy, was fatally injured after the structure gave way under the weight of numerous people who had climbed onto it. Two others were said to have been seriously injured in the incident but the injuries were reportedly not life-threatening. Several police officers tried to assist the boy and they freed him from the remains of the collapsed fountain. He died though due to the extent of his injuries.
Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World | URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0qvdy0jv05o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss]
Spain's streets were filled with revellers overnight on Sunday - pictured here in Los Palacios, Seville, more than 400km south of the incident

A 13-year-old boy was killed after part of a fountain collapsed in Salamanca province, northwestern Spain, during the country's World Cup victory celebrations.

Two other young people were injured, emergency services told the BBC, including one child who was taken to hospital with a possible broken bone in his leg.

Youth were celebrating Spain's victory inside the Árbol Gordo fountain in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo, when it partially collapsed around 00:30 local time (23:30 BST).

"What was supposed to be a celebration for the victory in the Spanish National Football Team's World Cup has turned into a tragedy," Ciudad Rodrigo's town hall posted on social media.

The remains of the Árbol Gordo fountain in Ciudad Rodrigo

Emergency services for Castilla y León said it had received several calls about the collapse of the fountain. Part of the structure gave way after several people climbed on it to celebrate Spain's win, local media reported.

The emergency service said it had notified the city's local police, as well as Salamanca's Civil Guard, its fire brigade and the local emergency medical service - which dispatched a mobile intensive care unit and a basic life support ambulance to the scene.

The emergency medical service later requested the presence of the Civil Guard at the local health centre to investigate the death of the boy who was treated there, the Castilla y León's regional government's website said.

It also requested the Civil Guard activate psychological support for the family.

The city's council said it "hopes for a speedy recovery of the others who have been affected by the incident".

Spain beat Argentina 1-0 in the World Cup final on Sunday after Ferran Torres scored in extra time.

It is the country's second ever World Cup win, after their last victory in 2010.

Earlier this month, three people died from suffocation during World Cup celebrations in Mexico City, while a 30-year-old man also died in an epileptic crisis.

[Lähde: Olive Press | URL: https://www.theolivepress.es/spain-news/2026/07/20/child-13-dies-after-fountain-collapses-during-spain-world-cup-celebrations/]
A YOUNG teenager died and several others were injured when a fountain collapsed during early Monday morning celebrations of Spain’s World Cup final victory over Argentina.

Emergency services received calls shortly after 12.30am reporting that a fountain had collapsed on multiple victims in Ciudad Rodrigo in the Castilla y Leon region- close to the border with Portugal.

The victim, a 13-year-old boy, was fatally injured after the structure gave way under the weight of numerous people who had climbed onto it.

Two others were said to have been seriously injured in the incident but the injuries were reportedly not life-threatening.

Several police officers tried to assist the boy and they freed him from the remains of the collapsed fountain.

He died though due to the extent of his injuries.

Ciudad Rodrigo council expressed its sadness and offered condolences for the death of the boy in a Facebook post on Monday.

“What should have been a celebration of Spain’s team in the football World Cup turned into tragedy,” the municipality said, confirming that several others were injured.

“The entire city feels this loss and joins the family and friends of the child in their pain,” it continued.

Spain claimed their first World Cup victory since 2010, sparking widespread celebrations across the country.

Authorities have not yet released further details about the extent of injuries sustained by others in the collapse or the condition of the injured youth.

Three days of official mourning have been declared in Ciudad Rodrigo

payload.title: 13-vuotias kuoli suihkulähteen sorruttua Espanjan MM-juhlissa
payload.summary: Ciudad Rodrigossa Espanjassa 13-vuotias poika kuoli ja kaksi muuta nuorta loukkaantui suihkulähteen sorruttua osittain jalkapallon maailmanmestaruusjuhlien aikana.
payload.content:
Kolmetoistavuotias poika kuoli ja kaksi muuta nuorta loukkaantui, kun Árbol Gordo -suihkulähde sortui osittain Espanjan jalkapallomaajoukkueen maailmanmestaruusjuhlien aikana Ciudad Rodrigossa varhain maanantaina. Nuoria oli kokoontunut suihkulähteelle juhlimaan Espanjan loppuotteluvoittoa Argentiinasta. Osa juhlijoista oli noussut rakennelman päälle tai mennyt sen sisään ennen sortumista. Onnettomuus sattui sunnuntain ja maanantain välisenä yönä, jolloin voittoa juhlittiin Espanjan kaduilla.

## Hätäilmoitukset tulivat puolenyön jälkeen

Ensimmäiset hätäilmoitukset tulivat hieman paikallista aikaa kello 00.30:n jälkeen. Pelastusviranomaisten mukaan soittajat kertoivat suihkulähteen sortuneen useiden ihmisten päälle. Ajankohta vastasi kello 23.30:tä Britannian kesäaikaa. Pelastusviranomaiset julkaisivat tiedon saamistaan puheluista X-palvelussa. Ciudad Rodrigo sijaitsee Salamancan maakunnassa Luoteis-Espanjassa, Castilla y Leónin alueella, noin 25 kilometriä Portugalin rajasta itään. Kyseessä on pieni rajaseudun kaupunki.

Julkaistujen tietojen mukaan suihkulähteen rakenteille oli kiivennyt runsaasti ihmisiä. Rakennelma antoi periksi heidän painonsa alla ja osa siitä romahti. Suihkulähteen sisällä olleet nuoret joutuivat keskelle äkillistä sortumaa. Hätäilmoituksissa puhuttiin useista ihmisistä, joiden päälle rakennetta oli pudonnut. Paikalla olleet poliisit ryhtyivät auttamaan ja saivat 13-vuotiaan pojan irrotettua suihkulähteen rikkoutuneiden osien keskeltä.

## Poika kuoli vakaviin vammoihinsa

Poika oli saanut onnettomuudessa erittäin vakavia vammoja. Poliisit yrittivät auttaa häntä, mutta hän kuoli vammojensa seurauksena. Ciudad Rodrigon kaupunginhallinto vahvisti 13-vuotiaan kuoleman Facebook-julkaisussaan, ilmaisi surunsa ja esitti osanottonsa hänen läheisilleen. Viestissä todettiin, että voitonjuhlaksi tarkoitetusta tapahtumasta oli tullut tragedia.

Kaksi muuta nuorta loukkaantui. Pelastusviranomaiset kertoivat BBC:lle, että ainakin yksi loukkaantuneista lapsista vietiin sairaalaan ja hänen jalassaan epäiltiin luunmurtumaa. Toisen tapahtumasta raportoineen julkaisun mukaan molempien nuorten vammat olivat vakavia, mutta eivät hengenvaarallisia. Lähteissä ei kerrottu tarkemmin toisen loukkaantuneen vammoista tai jatkohoidosta.

## Juhlat muuttuivat tragediaksi

Ciudad Rodrigon kaupungin viestissä puhuttiin yleisesti useista loukkaantuneista, kun taas pelastusviranomaiset yksilöivät kaksi muuta nuorta. Espanjan maailmanmestaruusvoittoa juhlittiin samana yönä laajasti eri puolilla maata, ja kadut täyttyivät juhlijoista. Ciudad Rodrigossa juhlat keskittyivät muun muassa Árbol Gordo -suihkulähteelle, jossa osittainen sortuma muutti yön kuolemaan johtaneeksi onnettomuudeksi.
summary_bullets: 13-vuotias poika kuoli Árbol Gordo -suihkulähteen sorruttua osittain.
Kaksi muuta nuorta loukkaantui, ja ainakin toinen vietiin sairaalaan.
Onnettomuus tapahtui Ciudad Rodrigossa Espanjan maailmanmestaruusjuhlien aikana.
payload.journalist_note: Kolmen uutisjulkaisun yhteiset tiedot vahvistavat tapahtumapaikan, kuolonuhrin iän ja kahden muun nuoren loukkaantumisen. Loukkaantumisten vakavuutta koskevat yksityiskohdat on ilmaistu varovaisesti.

Ciudad Rodrigon kaupungin viestissä puhuttiin yleisesti useista loukkaantuneista, kun taas pelastusviranomaiset yksilöivät kaksi muuta nuorta. Espanjan maailmanmestaruusvoittoa juhlittiin samana yönä laajasti eri puolilla maata, ja kadut täyttyivät juhlijoista. Ciudad Rodrigossa juhlat keskittyivät muun muassa Árbol Gordo -suihkulähteelle, jossa osittainen sortuma muutti yön kuolemaan johtaneeksi onnettomuudeksi.

Spain's streets were filled with revellers overnight on Sunday - pictured here in Los Palacios, Seville, more than 400km south of the incident A 13-year-old boy was killed after part of a fountain collapsed in Salamanca province, northwestern Spain, during the country's World Cup victory celebrations. Two other young people were injured, emergency services told the BBC, including one child who was taken to hospital with a possible broken bone in his leg. Youth were celebrating Spain's victory inside the Árbol Gordo fountain in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo, when it partially collapsed around 00:30 local time (23:30 BST). "What was supposed to be a celebration for the victory in the Spanish National Football Team's World Cup has turned into a tragedy," Ciudad Rodrigo's town hall posted on social media. The remains of the Árbol Gordo fountain in Ciudad Rodrigo

A TEENAGER HAS died, and several people were injured after a fountain collapsed during celebrations of Spain’s victory in the World Cup. “The city hall of Ciudad Rodrigo expresses its sadness and presents its condolences for the death of a boy of 13,” the municipality said on a Facebook post. “What should have been a celebration of Spain’s team in the football World Cup turned into tragedy,” it said, adding that several others were injured. Ciudad Rodrigo is a small city in the Salamanca region, about 25km east of the border with Portugal. “A few minutes after 12:30 am local time, rescue services received calls over a fountain collapsing on numerous people,” emergency services said in a post on X. It also said another young person had been injured.

A YOUNG teenager died and several others were injured when a fountain collapsed during early Monday morning celebrations of Spain’s World Cup final victory over Argentina. Emergency services received calls shortly after 12.30am reporting that a fountain had collapsed on multiple victims in Ciudad Rodrigo in the Castilla y Leon region- close to the border with Portugal. The victim, a 13-year-old boy, was fatally injured after the structure gave way under the weight of numerous people who had climbed onto it. Two others were said to have been seriously injured in the incident but the injuries were reportedly not life-threatening. Several police officers tried to assist the boy and they freed him from the remains of the collapsed fountain. He died though due to the extent of his injuries.

Two other young people were injured after a fountain partially collapsed in Salamanca's Ciudad Rodrigo.
